title: test(server): share repeated setup in four slow non-cli test files, budget five distinct floors
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X73hQETkXSTyG7U1jQZSGsv)_

Part of #23181 (slice 26). The card stays open: other `domain:server` files still read over 10 s (slices 24, 25, 27 and 28 hold the cli ones), and one cause found here needs a shared helper this slice may not edit (Acceptance notes).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：6 个非 cli 的服务端测试文件（plugin-auth、plugin-pinyin-search、rest、verify ×2、plugin-security）。4 个文件把重复执行的相同准备工作合并成一次（cloud-managed 只注册一次三个用户再给每个用例复制数据；posture-only 三次相同启动合成一次；pinyin 三个用例共用第一次 2,500 行遍历的数据库副本；promotion-selection 每种排序只跑一遍）；5 个文件加第 2 行 `// test-budget: 20` 头，因为剩下的地板是互不相同的真实工作。
- **为什么改**：卡 #23181 的测试提速职责：CI 里超过 10 s 的测试文件要么提速，要么按裁决 6181973363 B 声明预算。
- **风险与回滚**：只改测试文件，五个包的 `files[]` 都只发 `dist`、README、CHANGELOG，不发布任何东西；用例名和断言一条没删、没放宽（四个改动文件 base/head 用例名逐条一致）；回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/cloud-managed.test.ts`（`produceStagedRows` + 每例 `structuredClone` 复制）；`packages/plugins/plugin-pinyin-search/src/boot-reconcile.integration.test.ts`（`beforeAll` 的首次遍历与 `fromWalked`）；`packages/verify/src/harness.posture-only.test.ts`（合并的启动）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/cloud-managed.test.ts` → 32/32 通过，文件行约 2 s（base 约 6.5 s）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The six files slice 23's offender table (`pm-orders/server/evidence/23181-s23/offenders-after-s23.md`) lists outside `packages/cli`, read from the default reporter's per-file module line in the Test Core shard logs of the scheduled `ci.yml` runs `41199450735`, `41217827347`, `41237094739`, `41255489006` and `41271604267`:

| file | 0735 | 7347 | 4739 | 9006 | 4267 | tests | boots / staged units, base → head | distinct | cause | fix |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|:--|--:|:--|:--|
| `plugin-auth/src/cloud-managed.test.ts` | 6.9 | 19.9 | **23.6** | 15.3 | 6.8 | 32 | 14 stagings → 1 (3 fresh-salt production-scrypt sign-ups each, about 0.1 s apiece) | 1 | the same staging per case, plus 10 `#8243` cases re-run by importing `impersonation-bearer-rotation.test` | stage once in `beforeAll`; each case builds a fresh engine, `AuthManager` and mount over a `structuredClone` of the staged rows. No header (see Acceptance notes) |
| `plugin-pinyin-search/src/boot-reconcile.integration.test.ts` | 12.1 | 14.1 | 10.6 | 11.8 | **15.2** | 8 | 11 kernel boots → 10; 2,500-row seeds 7 → 5; full walks 9 → 7 | first walk ×3 | the first boot over the seeded history, walked with the ledger on, repeated by three cases | that walk runs once in the describe's `beforeAll` (readings taken while it is up); the three cases boot over a copy of the database it left (`fromWalked`). Header 20 |
| `rest/src/meta-draft-head-package-inheritance.test.ts` | 10.6 | 11.3 | 13.7 | 13.4 | **15.0** | 25 | 39 real-stack boots at about 12 ms (0.5 s of the file) | 25 | each case's own save/read/publish/discard sequence on the real `/meta` routes | header 20 |
| `verify/src/harness.key-custody.test.ts` | **14.2** | 7.0 | 9.1 | 13.6 | 10.3 | 7 | 5 `bootStack` boots, all in hooks | 5 | each boot is its cases' subject (empty home, key file, `OS_SECRET_KEY`, restart pair) | header 20 |
| `verify/src/harness.posture-only.test.ts` | **13.8** | 7.7 | 9.8 | 6.4 | 8.7 | 5 | 5 `bootStack` boots → 3 | 3 | three cases booted the same app with the same options and no posture set | one boot in a `beforeAll` takes all three cases' readings (tenancy fields and `org-scoping` while up, the posture before, during and after `stop()`). Header 20 |
| `plugin-security/src/bootstrap-platform-admin-promotion-selection.test.ts` | 9.5 | 7.1 | 10.9 | **13.5** | 7.3 | 25 | 27 engine boots → 24; card-population seeds 8 → 5 | per order ×2 | the per-order cases and the same-answer case each ran the same boot + seed + promotion per natural order | one pass per order in the describe's `beforeAll`; both sets of cases read it. Header 20 |

**Headers** (ruling 6181973363 letter B, class `spawns the real producer once per single-cause fixture`): N = the slowest of the five CI readings × 1.25, rounded up to 10 s; 20 for all five. Where the file also changed, the header keeps its pre-change CI reading. All five parse with `readTestBudget` (`scripts/measure-test-shard-timings.mjs`); `cloud-managed` reads `null` (no header).

Not changed: no case name, assertion, timeout, tier or project; no source file; no test helper (the shared `createMemoryEngine` double, `audience-gate-test-support`, the verify harness and the security testkits are untouched).

## Tests

- **A/B** (one box, one lock hold, base copied beside head as `zzbase.*`, interleaved, N=3, `--maxWorkers=1`, default reporter file line; copies deleted before the gate run):

  | file | base (s) | head (s) | change (mean) |
  |:--|:--|:--|--:|
  | `cloud-managed` | 7.08, 6.51, 6.03 | 2.21, 2.40, 2.15 | −65.9% (6.54 → 2.25) |
  | `harness.posture-only` | 6.58, 6.27, 4.94 | 4.55, 3.76, 4.11 | −29.0% (5.93 → 4.14) |
  | `promotion-selection` | 2.18, 2.10, 1.99 | 1.76, 1.78, 1.75 | −16.3% (2.09 → 1.76) |
  | `boot-reconcile.integration` | 3.89, 3.55, 3.38 | 3.05, 3.12, 3.05 | −13.6% (3.61 → 3.07) |

  Every run exit 0, same test counts both sides (32, 5, 25, 8). `vitest list` on base and head gives the same case names for all four files (posture-only's three cases sit one describe deeper).
- **Header-only files**, run on head: `meta-draft-head-package-inheritance` 25/25, `harness.key-custody` 7/7.
- `pnpm --filter PKG typecheck` (tsc + `check:test-typecheck`) exit 0 for `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, `plugin-pinyin-search`, `rest`, `verify`, `plugin-security`.
- No ablation: no tested behaviour changed (test-only).

## Acceptance notes

- **`cloud-managed` re-runs another file's ten cases.** It imports `createMemoryEngine` from `impersonation-bearer-rotation.test.ts`, and importing that file registers its ten `#8243` cases in the importer. On head they are about 2.3 s of the file's per-case time, against 0.85 s for its own 22 cases. 32 test files in `plugin-auth` import that double the same way, so each re-runs the same ten cases. The fix is a registration guard in that file (the shape `metadata-protocol/src/protocol.lock-one-resolution.kit.test.ts` already uses: register its suites only when it is the file under test), which is a helper shared beyond this slice's files, so it is not in this PR. That is why `cloud-managed` takes no header: its remainder is not distinct work. Carrier: #23181.
- **`skip-changeset`.** Test-only. All five packages ship `files: ["dist", "README.md", "CHANGELOG.md"]`; after build, a source symbol from each package is in its `dist/` (positive control) and a fixture string from each changed test is not, so no `files[]` content changes.

## Verification

All readings on head `978d4163` (two commits, then one merge of `origin/main` after slice 23, #28581, landed).

- **Derived gate families:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the final head → 54 families, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe, all exit 0, after a full `pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2` (the `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n` prerequisites) and `git fetch --depth=1` of the commit the teardown-shape self-test names. `--ran` reconciliation: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 54 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 54 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. List: `pm-orders/server/evidence/23181-s26-gates-ran-978d4163.txt` in the project files.
- **The six files on the final head:** 32/32, 8/8, 25/25, 7/7, 5/5, 25/25, every run exit 0.
- **Hand gates:** `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the six files exit 0 (none of the five packages has a `lint` script; the repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's); `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` exit 0.
- **CI** families (Test Core, lint farm, type-check lanes) are read off this PR's check-runs by the seat.
